title: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Package Days in the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Day Room
content:
Package days are added to the day room of a loss under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement. They come from the household's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package, according to the highest rental option rank that package allows:

- **3 days** when the package's highest allowed rental option rank is 6;
- **1 day** when that rank is 4 or 5;
- **none** when it is below 4.

The rank is the package's allowance, measured on the scale of the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement options from rank 1 (30/900) to rank 6 (100/3000). It is not the rank of the option the vehicle carries.

## Cases (hypothetical households)

- **Package allowing rank 6.** The vehicle carries 60/1800. The day room gains 3 days.
- **Package allowing rank 4.** The vehicle carries 40/1200. The day room gains 1 day.
- **Package allowing rank 2.** The day room gains no package days.
